title: Completing the augmented open projection square with its actual units
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$, a uniformizer $t$, and $A_n=R/t^n$ for $n\ge1$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. On each small pro-etale site put $B_W=\lim_n(A_n)_W$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients] and use the ordinary unbounded module derived category $D(B_W)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Open extension and restriction mean exact ringed-slice functors $e_!\dashv e^*$, applied termwise [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact].
Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be an open immersion of finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-weil-open-immersion], $K\in D^b_c(U,R)$ and $P\in D^b_c(X,R)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed]. For $H\in D(B_W)$ write $H_n=H\otimes^L_{B_W}(A_n)_W$ and $Q_W(H)_\bullet=(\operatorname{Res}_n H_n)_n$, with the strict quotient transitions; $\operatorname{Res}_n$ forgets to $B_W$-modules along $B_W\to(A_n)_W$ [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower]. Use flat-term K-flat representatives [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules, lem-pc-kflat-resolution], the total right derived inverse limit on strict towers, and its normalized Roos model and augmentation comparison [lem-cbc-exact-product-functor-strict-limit].
Let $H=j_!K\otimes^L_{B_X}P$, $H_U=K\otimes^L_{B_U}j^*P$, and $\gamma^B:H\xrightarrow{\sim}j_!H_U$ be the section-normalized ordinary open tensor map [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization]. Let $T_\bullet,S_\bullet,\gamma_\bullet:T_\bullet\xrightarrow{\sim}JS_\bullet$ be the strict finite tensor towers and augmented map of [lem-sf-open-tensor-quotient-augmentation]; thus $T_n=\operatorname{Res}_n((j_!K)_n\otimes^L_{A_n}P_n)$ and $S_n=\operatorname{Res}_n(K_n\otimes^L_{A_n}j^*P_n)$.
There is a specified natural isomorphism $\lambda_j:j_!R\lim S_\bullet\xrightarrow{\sim}R\lim JS_\bullet$: its Roos representative is the canonical product comparison on both signed mapping-fiber summands, and it carries the image of every strict augmentation to the corresponding strict augmentation [lem-cbc-exact-product-functor-strict-limit]. Define
$$\Gamma_{K,P}=\lambda_j^{-1}\circ R\lim(\gamma_\bullet):j_!K\widehat\otimes^L_RP\longrightarrow j_!(K\widehat\otimes^L_Rj^*P),$$
using the recorded completed tensor functors [def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. This is a natural isomorphism. With $\chi$ the actual quotient-augmentation tensor completion maps [lem-fix-constructible-tensor-completion], it satisfies the equality of actual morphisms
$$\Gamma_{K,P}\circ\chi_{j_!K,P}=j_!(\chi_{K,j^*P})\circ\gamma^B.$$
Both displayed $\chi$ maps are invertible, and under the canonical open units and completed tensor/restriction comparisons one has $j^*\Gamma_{K,P}=1$. In particular $\Gamma$ supplies the integral open projection datum of [def-exchange-projection], with its strict finite reductions and actual completion-unit normalization. The tensor/restriction comparisons here are those induced by restriction of the same augmented quotient systems and by the normalized exact-product limit map, including its units.

proof.text: Prove good-to-flat conversion by the definitions and extension preservation by the two fields m.kflat and m.preservesFlatTerms. Exactness of restriction follows from exact slice restriction composed with the coefficient equivalence. Apply [lem-sf-open-projection-ordinary-roos] for the normalized Roos, actual unit and ordinary tensor witnesses.
Apply [lem-sf-open-projection-completed-square] to obtain Gamma, its actual chi square, invertibility of both chi maps and its strict representative formula.

Define tensorRestriction as restriction of Gamma followed by the inverse derived unit, using whiskering, the functor associator and right unitor. Its displayed restriction identity follows by the component formulas and identity composition. Apply [lem-sf-open-projection-restriction-normalization] to this precise canonical isomorphism for the finite representative equation. Package all witnesses into CompletionData and then Completion without changing any clause.

proof_origin.place: C4 stage 3: unchanged completion specification assembled from ordinary descent, completed augmentation-square descent and restriction-unit normalization. The canonical tensor/restriction isomorphism and its component identity are constructed in Lean. Three shared proposition definitions name the original representative clauses verbatim to bound elaboration; expanding them restores the original CompletionData formula.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q158-fe40f6723 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: This answers the released re-split note of 2026-10-22, and live still has the 9-step Q140 proof, so no other group has re-split it. Compared with live, only proof, proof_deps and split_report changed; the statement and stmt_deps are unchanged. The old steps are spread over three new statement-only nodes of comparable size (2316, 2200 and 2029 characters of old text). (A) lem-sf-open-roos-extension-comparison carries old steps 1-2. Its hypotheses are met: lem-cbc-exact-product-functor-strict-limit applied to j_!, with exactness from lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact, exact products for any ring sheaf from lem-weil-proetale-countable-products-exact, and the invertible product map from lem-cbc-ringed-open-extension-products, which needs j quasi-compact. j is quasi-compact by the Nagata triangle lemma on U→X→Spec k, with no separatedness assumed. Stacks 09BP (proetale.tex l.5185) was read. (B) lem-sf-open-tensor-augmentation-limit-square carries old steps 4-6. The strict equality from lem-sf-open-tensor-quotient-augmentation, the augmentation coordinates ((c_n),0) and A's augmentation clause give L(γ•)a_T=λ_S j_!(a_S)γ^B. lem-fix-constructible-tensor-completion and def-sf-tensor-completion-comparison give a_T=χ and a_S=χ, invertible because j_!K and j^*P are constructible, the schemes are qcqs and ℓ is invertible; Bhatt–Scholze 6.5.5 and 6.5.8 were read. (C) lem-sf-open-roos-restriction-unit carries old steps 7-8. The unit equation type-checks and is true: after each projection it is naturality of u, so the composite is the product of the units on both summands. It overlaps lem-sp-slice-restriction-strict-derived-limit and lem-sf-open-roos-unit-adjunction only partly (they give the restriction comparison, the latter only for quotient towers), so it is not a duplicate. The assembly is 2229 characters and keeps old steps 3 and 9 as composition and inversion only. I re-derived step 4: by C and naturality of ρ, u⁻¹ j^*Γ = L(δ)ρ_T, and δ is the identity by lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization. Edge cases U=∅, j=id, K or P=0 and unbounded towers pass, and the strict-augmentation sign check holds. No argument was dropped or blurred, there is no cycle and no SGA source. Advisory: a future prover of C may cite lem-sp-slice-restriction-strict-derived-limit for the existence of ρ.
